about: VC figures for VCR2's market data, updated each quarter by hand from the reports (source, link and date for each). Official figures are added weekly by tools/market_data.py.

us.src: Clouded Judgement (Jamin Ball, Altimeter): public software index
us.note: Median EV ÷ next-12-month revenue. By projected growth: above 22%: 13.4x, 15 to 22%: 5.9x, below 15%: 3.3x.

eu.note: No verified European public-software index yet: the built-in exit multiple is used. The US index is 4.7x for reference.
